Hi Emma Wilson,

Yes — you may submit an itemized hotel receipt after returning from a business trip. The policy says to submit the receipt within 30 calendar days after the trip. Please note that the finance team must review and approve each reimbursement request, and submitting it does not mean payment has been approved or issued.

If you'd like, I can help you word the receipt submission message.

Please let us know if you need any further help.
Best regards,
Bright Operations Support
